describe: change the name or title of the game
guide: The name shown on the game window comes from pygame.display.set_caption("..."). Change the text inside it -- a comment does not change the window.
report: The game window is called "$title" now. You will see it at the top of the window when you press Run Game.
"$title" is the name on the window now.
I set the window title to "$title".
teach: pygame.display.set_caption sets the text in the window's title bar.
